rows.en:
(I made plans to hang out with Shirakawa today,
but...)
Man, Shirakawa's late...
(It's already been 30 minutes...)
Whoa! That scared me. Oh, it's my phone.

Hello?
It's me, Kagura.
Yuuto? What's up? Calling out of the blue...

What's up? I'll tell you what's up.
Shirakawa came down with a fever and collapsed.
rows.notes: x2, Kagura; doushita mo koushita mo nai yo.

rows.en: What? Shirakawa did?!

Yeah. I happened to spot her
staggering around outside, so I called
out to her and brought her back home.

She kept saying something about
having plans to hang out with you...
Well, yeah, we did have plans to hang out, but...

So, sorry to ask, but could you go
over to Shirakawa's place and see her now?

I think Shirakawa would feel a lot better
if you came.
rows.notes: Male, Kagura (kimi in katakana); anshin suru.

rows.en:
I've got some stuff to take care of after this...
Okay, I'm counting on you!
H-hey! Yuuto!

...He hung up.
Anyway, I'd better hurry over to Shirakawa's!
Shirakawa? It's me...
rows.notes: Male; at her door, after her 'Yes?'.

rows.en: Oh, you're awake? Is it okay if I come in?
Wh-why are you here?

Well, Yuuto called me, so I rushed over.
I heard you collapsed...
Wait, why am I in bed?!
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, feverish and confused; she drops her polite speech in this scene.

rows.en:
Ahhh!! I-I'm so sorry!
And after you invited me out and everything!

Nah, it's fine. It can't be helped if you're sick.
More importantly, can I come in?
Oh, yes... come in...

How are you feeling?
You look a little feverish. Your face is red.
Is there anything you'd like to eat?
Nuh-uh...
Okay. But you'll have to eat properly later, okay?
(She really doesn't have much energy...)
...What is it?
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; noticing the player watching her.

rows.en:
You're sick, so you can lean on me more.
Times like this are the only times
you get to be pampered, you know.

Okay...
...Then I want rice porridge.
The kind with egg in it, lightly seasoned.
Haha, I'll do my best to make it.

(Man, looking after her today
really wore me out...)
Hm, a message... It's from Shirakawa.

Thanks for today.
I'll make it up to you sometime.
And the porridge was delicious.
(Sounds like she's feeling better. Good.)

(I made plans to hang out with Miyuki today,
but...)
Man, Miyuki's late...
Whoa! That scared me. Oh, it's my phone.
Kagura-kun? What's up? Calling out of the blue...
What? Miyuki did?!

I think Shirakawa would feel a lot better
if you came.
Ah! Kagura-kun?!

...He hung up.
Anyway, I'd better hurry over to Miyuki's!
Miyuki? It's me...
Oh, you're awake? Can I come in?

Well, Kagura-kun called me, so I rushed over.
I heard you collapsed...

Nah, it's fine. It can't be helped if you're sick.
More importantly, can I come in?
(Of course she doesn't have much energy...)

You're sick, so you can lean on me more.
I'll do whatever you ask.
Ahaha, okay, I'll do my best to make it.

(Phew, looking after her today
kinda wore me out...)
Hm, a message... It's from Miyuki.

(I've got plans to go out with Shirakawa today,
but...)

Hey, Shirakawa. You're not overdoing it today?
If you're feeling rough, tell me up front, okay?
You're still going on about that...?
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; itsu no hanashi o shite iru n desu ka.

rows.en: Thanks to a certain someone, I'm all better.
So, what should we do today?

There's a movie I've been wanting to see.
Would you like to see it with me?
Yeah, sounds good. Let's go.
That movie was really good, huh?
It was even better than I expected...

Oh, let's keep talking about it
over something to eat.

(The movie was great, and the food was delicious.
That was a nice change of pace.)

(I've got plans to go out with Miyuki today,
but...)

Miyuki, you're not overdoing it today?
Are you okay?
I'm all better, thanks to you.
Yes, let's!
rows.notes: x3: Miyuki here, Nanase in frd_nns_007; always answers a 'let's' suggestion.

rows.en:
(The movie was great, and the food was delicious.
That was a nice change of pace~)
